tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Search Antarum's catalog of 120+ robots by free text, category, use, price limit, status and the user's country. Returns each robot with the price for that country (approx when converted, plus what the price includes), status, the date Antarum last checked it and its Antarum page.

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Everything Antarum knows about one robot: price for the user's country with source and check date, what the price includes, status, specs, versions, why it is in the catalog, what bothers Antarum about it, how to buy it in that country (shops, or through Antarum), rental, comparisons and the Antarum

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Two to four robots side by side: price for the user's country, status, check date and key specs, plus Antarum's comparison page when there is one.

tools.name: find_rental
tools.description: Robots to rent for events (with operator) in the user's country or city: from-prices (net), what they cover, the Antarum rental page and how fast Antarum answers. Rental firms stay unnamed until they make an offer.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Sends the user's inquiry (buy, rent, business, advice) to the Antarum team by e-mail. For when the user has seen the exact inquiry and their e-mail address and agreed to send it. Antarum answers by e-mail (rentals within 24 hours Monday to Friday, otherwise within 1 to 2 business days), free of char
